final: SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) AS share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
